interpretation: Same steps do not imply equal compute. Report actual teacher, forward, native-label and GPU cost. Actual physical intervention and learned heldout benefit remain separate. Rare failure support limits statistical power.
resource_rule: Only allowlisted owned spare GPUs/identified pressure yielding; never stop genuine Base/other jobs; original pressure monitor requalifies after jobs.
